hints.title: Length Validation
hints.text: An acronym must match the word count exactly in length.

hints.title: Initial Letter Comparison
hints.text: Each character s[i] must equal the first letter of words[i].

hints.title: Single Pass
hints.text: Check if len(words) equals len(s) and all(w[0] == c for w, c in zip(words, s)).

hints.title: Implementation

complexity.notes: Direct character comparison across list elements.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Building intermediate acronym strings incurs unnecessary string allocations.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Check lengths first for early termination, then compare initial characters.
